newsitem.title: UK: LME list stocks under source of origin.
newsitem.headline: LME list stocks under source of origin.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) has published warehouse stocks data showing the source of origin, by area, as on March 31 1997.
An LME notice said that it is proposed that a similar list will be published next year with information as at March 31, 1998.
Should the LME and the London Clearing House introduce an automated warrant depository system,(WADS), more frequent publication of brands per location will be reconsidered.
The daily publication, by brand name, of LME warranted metal and reported metal subject to cancelled LME warrants, is not practical at present due to the sheer volume of such data.
Also, there has not been a clear consensus on the part of the base metals industries of the world - the core of the LME's client base - that such data should be published, the LME notice said.
As at March 31, 1997 LME warranted stocks, shown by source of origin, were as follows, in tonnes -
Africa Asia & North Latin West Cen Euro
